0022600122.text: The Miami Heat (0-2, 0-2 at home, on a two-game losing streak) host the Dallas Mavericks (1-1, on a one-game win streak) in the Heat's fourth game of the 2026-27 season, with Miami 5th in the Southeast and 2 games back and 15th in the East. Dallas, 3rd in the Southwest and 9th in the West, is missing six players: Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and last met on 2025-12-03 in Dallas, where the Heat lost 118-108.
